evals.name: backlog-recovery-fresher
evals.prompt: bhai help kardo. mai BTech CSE first year hu, mid-sem exams 3 weeks mein hai. mene kuch nahi padha. backlog hai 4 subjects mein — maths, programming, digital logic, english. roz sochta hu kal se padhunga but phone lagta hai 6-7 ghante roz. sleep schedule bhi kharab hai — 3am ko sota hu, 12pm tak uthta hu. kya karu? pls koi system batao.
evals.expected_output: Assessment plan with backlog recovery strategy, daily schedule, priority subjects, and habit system for the student

evals.name: procrastination-and-consistency
evals.prompt: i always make plans but never follow them for more than 2-3 days. i've tried todo lists, notion, google calendar, everything. after a few days i just stop and feel guilty. then i make a new plan and the cycle repeats. im in my 3rd semester rn and my cgpa dropped from 8.5 to 6.2. i know i can study but i just don't execute. what's wrong with me and how do i actually fix this.
evals.expected_output: Root cause analysis of the procrastination cycle, execution-focused system design, and behavior change strategy

evals.name: exam-prep-strategy
evals.prompt: ok so i have 4 weeks until my end-sem exams. 5 subjects — 3 theory (os, dbms, cn) and 2 math (probability, linear algebra). i haven't started properly but i have watched some lectures. my attention span is maybe 20-30 mins max. i get distracted easily. i can study 4-5 hours a day if i push myself but not consistently. give me a day-by-day plan that actually works for someone like me.
evals.expected_output: Exam preparation strategy with spaced revision cycles, subject prioritization, focus techniques, and a realistic daily plan

evals.name: semester-planning-system
evals.prompt: next semester start ho raha hai aur mai iss baar genuinely consistent rehna chahta hu. pichle 2 semesters me same story rahi — first 2 weeks full motivation, then gradual decline, then last minute rush before exams. mai abhi se system banana chahta hu jo poore semester chal sake. what should i do? i have 6 subjects, some are heavy on theory, some are practical/coding subjects. help me build a system that survives the semester.
evals.expected_output: Full semester system design with weekly/daily structure, habit stacking, review cycles, and sustainability mechanisms

evals.name: burnout-recovery-restart
evals.prompt: i completely burned out last semester. was studying 10-12 hours daily before exams, got sick, performed badly anyway. now its been 2 months of break and i cant bring myself to open any book. i feel anxious just thinking about studying. i need to start again but idk how. im in my 2nd year BTech. please help me restart without making things worse.
evals.expected_output: Burnout recovery plan with gradual restart strategy, anxiety management, minimal initial load, and momentum building
